scope: Read-only source review of command subprocess, timeout, post-state and public projection paths; controlled workflow, not a hostile-operator boundary.

blockers.finding: Git subprocesses have no timeout, including network-backed ls-remote. After each child only runtime, HEAD and worktree are checked; remote, branch and production context are not rechecked. Run 2 can produce final success despite remote drift during the child, and a git operation can prevent bounded completion.
blockers.minimal_fix: Use bounded git calls and the complete source/branch/remote/production-context state check after each child, preserving independently obtained runtime state if the check fails.

blockers.finding: Launch errors, runtime-snapshot errors, and post-child git errors propagate before execution.json is written. Raw files and start.json may survive, but no closed completion/unknown-state receipt or stopped summary is produced.
blockers.minimal_fix: Record launch/completion state and available log hashes in an exception-safe path, represent unavailable state/exposure as unknown, emit a constant closed stop reason, and forbid continuation.

coordinated_public_projection_concern.finding: The wrapper prints the entire exposure object and unvalidated first_rejection_stage/same_entry_local_checks values. Its local checks do not close every emitted key/type/value. Parent owns complete report-shape and exposure validation review; this review does not duplicate that finding as a separate blocker.

positive_findings: Command argv is fixed to the current interpreter, reviewed diagnostic script, diagnose, and run 1 or 2; no shell or arbitrary command/URL input.
subprocess.run enforces a 100-second timeout for the direct child and kills/reaps that child on TimeoutExpired; process-group support is not required by this review for the fixed diagnostic.
Raw child stdout/stderr are redirected to exclusive files under fresh mode-0700 directories and are not echoed directly.
Canonical stdout must equal the fixed public receipt before its projected summary is printed.
A timeout, nonempty stderr, wrong return code, malformed output or failed assertion stops before run 2; there is no automatic retry.
